description: This file defines the ConnectException class within the GuzzleHttp library, specifically for handling network connection errors. It extends from TransferException and implements NetworkExceptionInterface, representing an exception thrown when a network connection cannot be established.

classes.name: ConnectException
classes.description: An exception class that signifies a failure to establish a network connection. It includes additional properties to store the request that caused the exception and contextual handler information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, the request that caused it, an optional previous throwable, and handler context information.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the original request object that led to the exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Provides contextual information about the error from the underlying handler.
